title: k8s-mcp-server default SSE transport exposes unauthenticated Kubernetes tools
summary: Default SSE/HTTP dispatch lacks caller authentication and Origin checks. Any reachable client can invoke tools with the configured cluster privileges, including destructive tools.

severity.rationale: The MCP listener exposes privileged Kubernetes operations without credentials. Cluster credentials and workload integrity require urgent protection.

exposure: Default SSE mode binds all interfaces and registers write tools unless read-only mode is selected. A client must reach the listener.

params.instructions: Check github.com/reza-gholizade/k8s-mcp-server version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
